Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項

  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は

【Full Story】
## Main Story

Some games are decided by one wild inning. This one had a clearer shape: Hanshin struck first, its starter held the game steady, and the Tigers added more later.

On August 16 at Mazda Stadium, Hanshin took control in the first inning. Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field, putting the Tigers ahead 2-0.

That early lead was supported by a steady start from Rihito Ihara. The Hanshin pitcher worked five innings, allowed only two hits, and gave up one run. Hiroshima scored during Ihara’s outing, but Hanshin stayed ahead.

The Tigers added more runs in the seventh and eighth innings, turning a good start into a wide gap.

Hiroshima could not answer with enough runs. Hanshin controlled the game until the final out.

The result was an 8-1 win for Hanshin.

It was a complete performance, not a one-moment victory. Sato provided the early power, Ihara gave the team a stable base, and the offense finished the job late.

【Point One】
Hiroshima’s answer came from Elehuris Montero, who hit a solo home run in the fifth inning. It reduced the deficit, but it did not lead to more scoring. The home run changed the number on the board, not the basic shape of the game.

【Point Two】
Hanshin’s final advantage was built by more than the opening home run. In the seventh, Seishiro Sakamoto and pinch-hitter Tora Fushimi each delivered an RBI hit. In the eighth, Sakamoto added an RBI double. Different hitters turned later chances into runs.
